note: Sweep closed: every one of the 63 served pages was fetched with cache disabled, compared byte for byte against the repository (0 drift) and scanned sentence by sentence. Zero claims about the old economics are left undated. The last six were: "the vault continues accumulating SOST regardless" (FAQ), "25% of all fees continue accumulating gold reserves in perpetuity" (archived announcement), "Receives exactly 25% of each block" on the vault address card, and two in the whitepaper reader. The Gold Reserve page reported a status that was false: a green ACCUMULATING badge and "Every mined block allocates 25% of issuance to an on-chain Gold Vault by consensus". The vault stopped receiving emission at block #25,000 - its share is 0. It now reads NO LONGER FUNDED, states that governed spending was never active, and repeats that SOST is not backed by gold and the vault keeps only what it already holds. Remaining headings and table cells across the site (Coinbase Split (50/25/25), bare "25% of every block" allocations) are dated too. Every remaining present-tense claim about the old economics is now dated at the sentence level, not just covered by a page banner: twenty of them across twelve pages plus the README ("accumulates 25% of every block reward", "split 50/25/25", "Constitutional immutability - 50/25/25 split"). Each now carries its height range - 50/25/25 for blocks 0-24,999, 50/50 miner/DTD since #25,000 - so a reader skimming one paragraph cannot come away with the wrong rule. The homepage was the page still telling a new visitor the old story, and it was NOT a caching problem: the served bytes matched the repository exactly, with Cache-Control no-store. Nine separate claims were rewritten - the hero paragraph ("every block mined allocates 25% to an on-chain Gold Vault and 25% to PoPC"), the "Up to 50% -> Gold" pillar, the "Coinbase Split 50/25/25" card, the "Constitutional Split - Every Block" panel with its doughnut chart and legend ("Hardcoded at genesis. Immutable."), the protocol summary, the specification table rows for Reserve and PoPC, and the genesis line. The homepage now opens with 50% miner / 50% DTD since V15 (#25,000), states that the gold and PoPC shares are zero, keeps the historical split dated and visible, and says plainly that SOST is not backed by gold. The explorer itself still said "Coinbase Split (every block, forever): 50% Miner - 25% Gold Vault - 25% PoPC Pool". Forever ended at block #25,000: the split is 50% miner / 50% DTD and the gold and PoPC shares are zero. Corrected, with the historical split kept and dated. The whitepaper stated in TWO places that the DTD lottery would require an active PoPC bond from block #30,000. Both are now corrected: it does not, at any height. The mainnet gate ships deactivated (DTD_POPC_GATE_CONSENSUS_ACTIVE = false) and the DTD is permissionless - mining one valid block is the only requirement, and V16 at #30,000 changes WHICH miners qualify (288-block recency, conditional cooldown and anti-dominance), never whether a bond is needed. ONE activation, said unambiguously. The notice heading read "First-Jackpot bootstrap - not another fork", which is true of the heartbeat ramp but was read by at least one reader as denying that anything activates at #30,000. It now says what it means: #30,000 is the only activation, it happens once and automatically by block height, and the 0/0 -> 1/1 -> 2/2 -> 3/3 -> 3/4 heartbeat ramp is that same rule counting completed epochs, not a second fork and not a second update. Gold and PoPC are now documented as HISTORY everywhere, because that is what they are on chain: since V15 (block #25,000) the coinbase splits 50% miner / 50% DTD and the Gold Vault and PoPC emission shares are ZERO - verified in the node's V15 emission-transition branch, not in a document. Their addresses and historical balances stay on chain and auditable; nothing new flows in, and SOST is not backed by gold: the metals reserve is a Foundation-held reserve with published policy, not a peg and not a redemption right. Corrected in place rather than deleted: the FAQ said every block allocates 25%+25%; the protocol spec validated blocks against 'the 50/25/25 split' without saying it changed at #25,000; the homepage's gold pillar read as current; and the whitepaper stated the DTD lottery would require an active PoPC bond from block 30,000 - it does not, DTD_POPC_GATE_CONSENSUS_ACTIVE is false on mainnet and the DTD is permissionless: mining one valid block is the only requirement. The explorer also claimed transaction fees are split 50/25/25 in the coinbase; they go to the miner. Twenty further pages that describe the old economics now open with a HISTORICAL ECONOMICS banner pointing at the current spec and the operator guide. #30,000 remains ONE automatic activation (V16: DTD-normal eligibility + independent Jackpot V2), first V2 draw #30,186, and the update window for operators is unchanged: node AND miner, after #29,900 and before #30,000.
